label.responsibilities:
As a Backend Engineer, you will work on specific problem domains, designing, developing, and deploying backend services with a focus on scalability, high availability, and low latency.
Drive the efficient delivery of change through analysis, definition, and documentation of requirements, while identifying potential solutions using agile delivery frameworks.
Solve complex technical and business problems and learn new technologies and frameworks.
Be part of a team that takes full responsibility for the features you own.
Design, develop, test, deploy, monitor, and improve - you are responsible for the full lifecycle of your product.
label.requirements:
A pragmatic mindset.
Outstanding problem-solving ability, eagerness to learn, and curiosity.
5+ years of software development experience with Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, Redis, Python (e.g., Django, Flask, FastAPI), or similar technologies.
Strong database and schema design skills for large-scale applications.
Experience developing distributed systems using microservices, serverless, and event-driven architectures.
Experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS).
Strong English skills to work comfortably with international teams and stakeholders.
Adaptable attitude and personality, ready for continuous change.
Collaboration and culture fit in an Agile environment.
